name: Sigenergy Solar Battery
tagline: Stackable LiFePO4 battery modules in 5 kWh and 8 kWh sizes.
summary: The Sigen Battery (SigenStor BAT) comes as 5.0 and 8.0 modules with 5.2 kWh or 7.8 kWh of usable energy. Up to six modules stack in one system.
It is rated IP66, can be floor standing or wall-mounted, and shows battery status in the mySigen App.

image.alt: Sigenergy Solar Battery stackable home battery

highlights.title: Multi-layer safety
highlights.text: Several layers of safety protection cover the whole battery.

highlights.title: mySigen App
highlights.text: See the battery's status in real time in the mySigen App.

highlights.title: AI optimisation
highlights.text: AI-enabled optimisation helps extend the battery's cycle life.

highlights.title: Flexible battery mix
highlights.text: Modules connect in parallel, so different sizes can be combined.
